messages:
Ashley: Quick weekly GPU capacity forecast — TL;DR: projected demand +32% over the next 4 weeks due to the Q4 marketing push and a new feature rollout. Primary pressure in us-west and ap-south. Requests:

```
Region   Cluster           CurrGPUs  ForecastGPUhrs/week  Delta
us-west  cluster-west-1    320       45,600              +35%
us-east  cluster-east-1    240       29,000              +22%
eu-west  cluster-eu-1      200       25,400              +7%
ap-south cluster-ap-1      80        14,000              +60%
```

Ashley: Asks: 1) Prewarm +40 GPUs in us-west (temp on-demand) by Tue 09:00 PT, 2) Reduce spot footprint in ap-south until preemption <5%, 3) Schedule eu-west networking patch during low window (Sun 02:00 UTC), 4) Approve finance estimate for reserved commit if cost-effective.

Miguel: Noted — eu-west had the LB flapping incident this morning. oncall-bot logged it: INC-2025-314 — LB healthcheck flips, ~18% failed requests, 03:20–04:05 UTC. Network jitter still visible on 10% of p95 flows. I recommend we avoid shifting more load to eu-west until the patch is in.

oncall-bot: INC-2025-314 created by monitoring-bot — severity: medium — affected: cluster-eu-1 — duration: 00:45 — remediation: failover to standby ALB and apply healthcheck backoff.

Priya: Cluster health notes — ap-south spot preemption rate 12% last 48h (up from 4% baseline). Node churn causing KV cache cold starts; embeddings latency p95 up 220ms. Suggest reducing spot to 30% of pool and increase reserved nodes until we hit <5% preemptions.

Sophia: Finance check — ballpark cost delta: +40 on-demand A100-class GPUs ~ $38k/mo. If we take reserved 1yr commit with 30% discount it's ~ $26.6k/mo (savings ~ $11.4k). Reducing spot in ap-south will increase run-rate by ~ $3.2k/mo. Need decision by EOD Fri to lock offers.

Oliver: Ops idea — we can enable the new quantization profile + smaller batch sizes on generation routes; expected GPU-hour reduction ~15–20% for gen-heavy workloads (will slightly increase tail latency). Can rollout a canary to 5% of traffic this afternoon.

Ashley: Good. Action items — @Miguel file change for eu-west ALB patch scheduling (owner), @Priya adjust ap-south scaling policy and reduce spot to 30% (owner), @Oliver start quantization canary at 17:00 UTC (owner), @Sophia prepare reserve vs on-demand payback calc and signoff threshold. I'll request the +40 prewarm in us-west after we confirm cost. :thumbsup:

Miguel: ACK. I'll also add a temporary routing rule to avoid cross-AZ egress in eu-west during the patch window.

Priya: ACK — will monitor preemption metric and post update here when stable <5%.

Sophia: I'll send the finance approval PR with numbers + break-even timeline.

Oliver: Can run canary and post perf diffs in this thread.

Ashley: Thanks everyone — I'll schedule a quick 15m sync Mon 08:30 PT to re-evaluate after initial changes. If anything pops before then, ping here or pager.

Priya: :raised_hands:
Miguel: :thumbsup:
Sophia: :eyes:
Oliver: :rocket:
